description: This file defines configuration and setup logic for integrating Microsoft Teams (MS Teams) into a larger application, including credential prompts, allowlist management, and setup wizard configuration.

methods.name: looksLikeGuid
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a GUID (hexadecimal with hyphens, at least 16 characters).

methods.name: promptMSTeamsCredentials
methods.description: Prompts the user to input MS Teams App ID, App Password, and Tenant ID.

methods.name: promptMSTeamsAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to specify allowlist entries for MS Teams allowFrom configuration.

methods.name: noteMSTeamsCredentialHelp
methods.description: Provides instructions on how to obtain MS Teams credentials.

methods.name: setMSTeamsTeamsAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the allowed MS Teams and channels in the configuration.

methods.name: listMSTeamsGroupEntries
methods.description: Lists MS Teams groups and channels from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsGroupAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves group allowlist entries, possibly resolving names to IDs via Microsoft Graph.
